target.title: fix(agents): use fetchWithSsrFGuard in minimax-vlm.ts instead of raw fetch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`src/agents/minimax-vlm.ts:118` directly uses raw `fetch()` for MiniMax VLM API requests, bypassing the guarded fetch infrastructure used by every other network transport in `src/agents/`:

| File | Transport |
|------|-----------|
| `provider-transport-fetch.ts` | `fetchWithSsrFGuard` + trusted env-proxy |
| `mcp-http-fetch.ts` | `fetchWithSsrFGuard` + env proxy eligible |
| `web-guarded-fetch.ts` | `fetchWithSsrFGuard` (strict) |
| `tools-manager.ts` | `fetchWithSsrFGuard` |
| **`minimax-vlm.ts` (before)** | **raw `fetch()`** |

The raw `fetch()` path misses: SSRF protection (DNS pinning + hostname allowlist + private network blocking), redirect safety (loop detection, cross-origin header stripping, max redirect limit), debug capture (`OPENCLAW_DEBUG_PROXY_ENABLED`), proper dispatcher lifecycle, and audit-context error classification.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is an architectural consistency fix. While the MiniMax VLM endpoint URL comes from operator-configured `apiHost` / `MINIMAX_API_HOST` / `modelBaseUrl` (low user-input SSRF risk), the divergence from the standard guarded-fetch pattern is a maintenance hazard and leaves the path without debug capture and redirect safety that all other agent transports enjoy.

## User Impact

No behavioral change for users. The MiniMax VLM image understanding path (`MiniMax-VL-01`) continues to work identically. The fix is transparent: same URL, same headers, same body — just routed through `fetchWithSsrFGuard` with `withTrustedEnvProxyGuardedFetchMode` (matching `provider-transport-fetch.ts`).

## Evidence

- `src/agents/minimax-vlm.normalizes-api-key.test.ts`: **13/13** ✅
- `src/media-understanding/image.test.ts` (MiniMax paths): **32/32** ✅
- `src/agents/tools/image-tool.test.ts` (MiniMax VLM routing): **12/12** ✅
- 3 pre-existing `image-tool.test.ts` failures due to corporate network proxy intercepting `example.invalid` — unrelated to this change (`FailoverError: fetch failed`)

### Changes

- Replace raw `fetch()` with `fetchWithSsrFGuard` + `withTrustedEnvProxyGuardedFetchMode`
- Remove `ensureGlobalUndiciEnvProxyDispatcher()` (guarded fetch handles proxy routing in trusted env-proxy mode)
- Wrap response handling in `try/finally` to ensure dispatcher `release()` on all code paths
- Update test mocks across 3 test files to work with the guarded fetch interface
